decision: Retain orthographic. Do not globally tighten framing from Screen-Space Breakpoint v1; next camera work must be aspect-ratio-aware, especially for portrait mobile.

screen_space_breakpoint_v1.decision: Do not promote tighter B/C as one global framing. Retain orthographic/current global framing pending aspect-ratio-aware mobile home-pose proof.
screen_space_breakpoint_v1.key_finding: 16:9 benefits from tighter screen-space; portrait mobile is already crop-limited rather than scale-limited.
